title: Figure 4. Representation of Performance Results from Brookings Study (bar chart)
description: Bar chart of "Percent Performance Points" (0–100) by workload level (Low, Medium, High, Max), with blue bars for "Volume," maroon bars for "Complexity," and a pale yellow bar for "Overload" at Max. Captioned "Figure 4. Representation of Performance Results from Brookings Study," noting that only the low-complexity, 12-plane scenario showed near 100% primary task performance.
